value.rationale: All-dimensional unrestricted sharp universal real Banach-valued operator constants on a natural three-parameter paired equilateral metric are determined. The surprising independence of the within-target metric, coefficient-support disappearance at a sharp ratio, and strictly expansive saturation for n>=4 are structural phenomena, not isolated arithmetic.
